outputPath.description: Workspace-relative folder holding the BuildPlugin packages under package, the source archive of each engine under archive, and automation reports under report

descriptor.description: Project .uproject or .uplugin, relative to the workspace root

hosts.description: .uproject files loading a plug-in, whose engine associations name each engine it builds, tests, and packs on

dependencies.description: Workspace plug-ins a .uplugin names, passed to BuildPlugin as -Dependencies

packages.description: Packages installed into folders of a .uplugin before each BuildPlugin run, each target reading the engine root from UNREAL_ENGINE_ROOT and taking its install folder under --prefix, absent installing none

users.description: .uproject files enabling a plug-in that sits outside their plug-in folders, each receiving the package on install

operation.description: What runs: the build, the build under UnrealBuildTool static analysis, the automation tests named after the plug-in, the archives, or the copy into each user project

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Unreal
description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, with its Clang static analyzer, unity builds off, and no precompiled headers for a check, or for a .uplugin packages it through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin with strict includes once per engine on this machine its hosts name, skipping a host whose engine is absent, after each package its descriptor maps to a folder installs there under a .gitignore holding *, runs the automation tests named after it through UnrealEditor-Cmd in each host and reads their result from the exported report, zips the tracked sources with those installed packages and the engine's EngineVersion once per engine after the Fab store checks pass, or copies the package into the Plugins folder of each user project, swapped in for the one installed there
